serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-elicitation-auditor
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans MCP server code for elicitation anti-patterns in the 2026-07-28 spec: form mode asking for secrets, URL mode pointed straight at a third-party authorize endpoint, and credentials or PII embedded in the elicitation URL

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan MCP server source for elicitation anti-patterns: form mode requesting secrets, URL mode opened directly on a third-party authorize endpoint, and credentials or personal data embedded in the elicitation URL.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for elicitation anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of MCP server source for elicitation anti-patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every elicitation check this auditor runs
